title.value: Improving Geo-diversity of Generated Images with Contextualized Vendi Score Guidance
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the beginning of the paper where it introduces the subject matter of the research.
title.quote: Improving Geo-diversity of Generated Images with Contextualized Vendi Score Guidance

analysis.description: This paper aims to increase the geo-diversity of images generated by text-to-image models by introducing an inference-time intervention called contextualized Vendi Score Guidance (c-VSG). The method improves diversity by guiding the latent diffusion models (LDMs) to generate images that are more diverse and representative of real-world geographic variations. The efficacy of this approach is evaluated using datasets like GeoDE and DollarStreet, showing improved diversity while maintaining image quality and consistency.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the c-VSG method using geographically diverse datasets, indicating that the study is empirical in nature.
type.quote: We evaluate c-VSG with two geographically representative datasets and find that it substantially increases the diversity of generated images.

name.justification: The primary research focus is on improving text-to-image generative models, particularly with regard to geographic diversity.
name.quote: With the growing popularity of text-to-image generative models, there has been increasing focus on understanding their risks and biases. Recent work has found that state-of-the-art models struggle to depict everyday objects with the true diversity of the real world.

name.justification: The paper introduces an intervention for latent diffusion models (LDMs) to improve geo-diversity.
name.quote: We present Contextualized Vendi Score Guidance (c-VSG), an inference-time intervention to increase the diversity of images generated by latent diffusion models (LDMs).

name.justification: The paper discusses biases in generated images and aims to mitigate geographic portrayal biases in text-to-image models.
name.quote: Recent works have highlighted through qualitative and quantitative evaluations the disparities in demographic traits of people represented in the generated images.

name.justification: The study applies interventions to latent diffusion models to enhance diversity among generated images.
name.quote: c-VSG shows significant improvement in diversity and quality over the vanilla LDM, while maintaining text-image consistency.

is_contributed.justification: While the Latent Diffusion Model was used as part of the study, the novel contribution was the c-VSG method rather than the LDM itself.
is_contributed.quote: We evaluate c-VSG with two geographically representative datasets and find that it substantially increases the diversity of generated images.

is_executed.justification: The paper applies the c-VSG method on LDMs, which indicates they were executed as part of the experiments.
is_executed.quote: We present Contextualized Vendi Score Guidance (c-VSG), an inference-time intervention to increase the diversity of images generated by latent diffusion models (LDMs).
